title: Bolt vs Emergent AI: Which Vibe Coding Platform Should You Use in 2026?
summary: Bolt wins on code quality and generous tokens. Emergent wins on agentic workflows. Neither ships the full stack — honest comparison plus the third option.
body_markdown: It can be. One Emergent credit = one agent task, but task complexity varies. A simple UI tweak might use 0.5 credits; a complex backend change might use 3-5 credits. Heavy iterators on the Standard plan (100 credits/month) can burn through the allotment in a week of active building. Extra credits are available for purchase but add unpredictable cost. Bolt's token-based model is more predictable — you see the token balance deplete in real time.[Blink](https://blink.new/) uses a flat monthly subscription model with no per-task charges, making the cost fully predictable regardless of iteration volume.
